name: proseweaving
description: Proseweaving: house standards and verification for agent-authored human-facing prose.

interface.shortDescription: Write and check human-facing prose to house standards.
interface.longDescription: Proseweaving holds the portable register, evidence discipline, and post-draft edit passes for prose that agents write to people, and the adversarial pass that checks a finished draft before it ships.
defaultPrompt: Use $proseweaving:editing-finished-drafts to check this finished draft or batch against its evidence and intended recipient, repair prose tells and unsupported claims, and preserve its purpose, useful wording, and required form.

Use $proseweaving:writing-for-people to ground this human-facing text in the available evidence, choose phrasing and structure for its medium and audience, lead with its subject, and apply the edit pass before delivery.
